programme.desc: The Snake Pit: Simon has his hands full with a black mamba that does will not be caught, a cobra hiding in a room of old sacks and a snake in a car! 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Goats Gone Wild: The fair's in town and Dr Pol is busier than ever making sure his clients have healthy cows, sheep and pigs to show. 7+. (S3, ep 16)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Hug for a Pug: Join Dr Oakley as she treats an enormous bull with a split hoof, an aging elk, and her own family's pet pug. (S8, ep 21) 7+

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programme.desc: Uncertainty of the Future: Alaska Natives race the ticking clock as a harsh winter threatens to unfurl. 16+. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Flu the Coop: Dr Brenda struggles to find out what is causing a dog to be so lethargic, as she learns from his owner that he might have been exposed to marijuana. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Tunnel of Love: As the sea lions rejoice over the long-awaited opening of Adventure Cove, a tiny loris and beloved iguana present strange mystery illnesses. (S5, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Monster Under the Bed: Snakecatchers Simon and Siouxsie race to the rescue when a huge black mamba is found in a child's bed. Later, a deadly spitting cobra turns on Siouxsie. (S4, ep 5)

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Rwanda: Blanketed by mists and bordered by jungles, Rwanda is a country cloaked in mystery. Here, discover great apes and some of the continent's most mysterious landscapes. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Shark Men
programme.desc: The Hot Spot: The crew's plans to catch a big shark are scuppered when a smaller male steals the bait. But this feisty young shark might prove a great catch after all. 7+ (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Dinner and a Moo-Vie: The vets visit a sick cat at an antique store which leads to some vintage finds. They also treat a hawk with a life-threatening injury. 7+ (S3, ep 8)

programme.title: Europe's Wild Places
programme.desc: Winter's Grip: Europe is covered in snow, forcing hardships on its winter wildlife including lynx, arctic foxes and wolves. Only the most resourceful can thrive. 7+ (S1, ep 1 of 2)

programme.title: Europe's Wild Places
programme.desc: Springtime Survival: Spring sees baby wildlife born across Europe, as parents teach and protect. Follow seal pups, geese, marmots and more as they strive to survive. (S1, ep 2 of 2) 7+

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Killers in the Water: Diva uncovers a change in shark bites along the South African coast, before developing a unique experiment to test the sharks' countershading. 12+. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Testing Times: A Labrador has his first day as a drug sniffer, the managers see if they can smuggle a fake bomb past their screening teams and Annie faces her moment of truth. (S1, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: The Big Bad Wolf: Dr Oakley and her daughters travel to the AWCC where they attempt to bond with a lone wolf. Plus, they give a bald eagle a much-needed mani and pedi. (S7, ep 13)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Oh, The Hu-Manatee: The team welcome two manatees to the Zoo Tampa Manatee hospital, and say goodbye to chimpanzees Twiggy, Jamie and Nick. 7+ (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Pole To Pole With Will Smith
programme.desc: The Himalayas: Will travels to the kingdom of Bhutan on a deeply intimate journey in search of the secret to happiness. (S1, ep 5) 7+

programme.title: Pole To Pole With Will Smith
programme.desc: The Pacific Islands: Linguist Dr Mary Walworth and local marine ecologist John Aini join Will as he travels to the South Pacific to an island threatened by rising seas. (S1, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Spy Islands: Abandoned structures near Antarctica hear eerie sounds, mysterious slabs appear on beaches and rumours of a lost island persist. 7+. (4 of 10)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Big Boss Battle: Rescue bosses Bjørn and Thord must gather a ten-man team to recover a capsized trailer and its valuable cargo. 7+ (S6, ep 6)

programme.title: It Spent HOW Long At No.1 ?!
programme.desc: Once these tracks made it to the top spot there was no knocking them off! The 50 longest chart toppers of the 00s - every song spent at least 3 weeks at the summit.

programme.title: Sold & Downloaded: The UK's Best!
programme.desc: From physical sales in the 90s to digital downloads in the 00s! Every track was a smash hit and every video a UK chart number one!

programme.title: 20 Big Selling US Songs of the 90s
programme.desc: Which singles by US acts sold more in the UK than any other is the 90s? We reveal all over 2 hours - you'll be surprised who's missing!

programme.title: Forgotten Favourites!
programme.desc: Pop hits & hidden gems that you have definitely heard but probably forgotten you loved! Including Westlife, Britney, Backstreet Boys, The Spice Girls & loads more!

programme.title: Pat Sharp's 40 Guilty Pleasures!
programme.desc: Songs from the 00s that you really like, but are a bit too embarrassed to admit? If that's the case then Pat Sharp urges you to have a little less shame in your musical game!

programme.title: Mellow Moments!
programme.desc: Kick back and relax with some mellow moments. Chilled to perfection.

programme.title: Sold & Downloaded: The UK's Best!
programme.desc: From physical sales in the 90s to digital downloads in the 00s! Every track was a smash hit and every video a UK chart number one!

programme.title: The NOW 100 Of The 00s
programme.desc: Mark Goodier with a definitive countdown of the 100 biggest acts of the 00s - compiled using record sales, concert tickets, awards & more - from the UK, the USA & around the world!

programme.title: Non-Stop 00s No.1s!
programme.desc: Every track a smash hit, every video a UK chart number one in the 00s. What more could you possibly need in life!

programme.title: One Hit Wonder No.1s!
programme.desc: 60 minutes of acts that had a single smash hit number 1, then never darkened the top 20 ever again! From Maria McKee in 1990 to Baz Luhrmann at the end of the decade.

programme.title: Pat Sharp - Madly In Love!
programme.desc: Pat fires Cupid's arrow at 30 hits that made us madly in love! With uplifting dance bangers, cool RnB and perfect pop moments that are truly timeless.

programme.title: Dreamlovers!
programme.desc: Who were your "Dreamlovers" of the 90s and 00s? These are songs that made the soundtrack to young love!

programme.title: Love In A Single Word! 1990-1999
programme.desc: Classic love & bittersweet 90s classics, all summed up in a single word title - As, Amazed, Pray, Crying, Lifted, Anything, Dreams, Wonderwall & more.

programme.title: Because You Loved Me!
programme.desc: Dedicated to that someone special, timeless 90s love songs all from the heart.

programme.title: Mariah Carey: Power Diva
programme.desc: Starting in 1990, two hours of powerhouse ballads, legendary love songs & pure emotion that can only be delivered by a musical queen. This is the incredible Mariah Carey!

programme.title: Turn Up The Alt Rock Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn up your speakers to 11 & live life even louder! 50 alt rock anthems in order, featuring Imagine Dragons, Blink-182, The Killers & The Foo Fighters!

programme.title: Rated Rock! The No.1s
programme.desc: Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys & KOL right back to legends like The Stones & T.Rex!

programme.title: Nicky Horne's 30 Bad Ass Videos!
programme.desc: Nicky Horne presents his favourite 30 Kick Ass Videos. which need to sit in the hall of fame for Rock Video Greatness. Featuring Bon Jovi, David Bowie, Kate Bush, Nirvana and Ozzy!

programme.title: Great British Rock
programme.desc: From Joy Division to The Stones, Zeppelin to Queen. Some of the best bands in the world came from right here in the UK!

programme.title: High School Rock Out: 1995-2005
programme.desc: We open the high school year book with Weezer in 1995 and remember the amazing bands that rocked every school party through to 2005!

programme.title: The Friday FeelGood 50!
programme.desc: 50 of the biggest most uplifting, feel good rock songs! With anthems from Jet, Queen, Kiss and David Bowie.

programme.title: Rock's Most Streamed of the 00s!
programme.desc: Mark Goodier with a countdown of bands and artists who've had one rock song that has been viewed over a billion times since the 00s.

programme.title: The Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn it up to 11 for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

programme.title: Monsters of Rock! 1990-1999
programme.desc: A definitive 6 hour marathon of 90s guitar anthems! From U2 to INXS, Blur to Bon Jovi, Skunk Anansie to Green Day, Metallica to Iron Maiden - 70 rock classics are here, in order!

programme.title: 30 Rock & Indie Heroes of the 10s
programme.desc: Claire Sturgess relives the 2010s with her 30 greatest heroes in rock and indie. The Vaccines, Biffy Clyro and Imagine Dragons are all in the Top 10, but who is her number 1?

programme.title: Weekend Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

programme.title: All Killer: Stateside Anthems!
programme.desc: In order, 20 of the biggest American anthems from the 21st Century featuring The Killers, Bon Jovi, Nickelback and OneRepublic.

programme.title: Party Rock Anthems!
programme.desc: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

programme.title: Rated Rock! The No.1s
programme.desc: Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys & KOL right back to legends like The Stones & T.Rex!

programme.title: 10 Biggest Legends Of The 80s
programme.desc: Rock Gods & Goddesses that were massive in the 80s & have stood the test of time ever since! Here are the 10 biggest selling & the most streamed legends the decade has to offer!

programme.title: Heart & Soul: 50 Rock Ballads
programme.desc: Carol Decker from T'Pau with 50 Rock Ballads written from the Heart and Soul! With Queen, Bon Jovi, Cutting Crew and Bonnie Tyler.

programme.title: Blazing Rock Ballads!
programme.desc: The Biggest Ballads from the royals of rock! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Nickleback & Evanescence.

programme.title: 80s Soft Rock Classics
programme.desc: One hour of pure laid back tracks and big power ballads from the 80s, every song with a huge chorus! Expect plenty of Foreigner, Toto, U2 and Heart.

programme.title: The First Ladies of Rock 1985-2015
programme.desc: Starting in 1985, these are the power ladies who really rock! Expect Pink, Hayley Williams, Joan Jett, Sheryl Crow, Bonnie Tyler, Alanis Morissette & many more!

programme.title: Weekend Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

programme.title: Turn Up The 00s Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn up your speakers to 11 & live life even louder! 50 All-Killer Anthems in order from Blink 182 in 2000 to The Killers at the end of the Decade!

programme.title: The New Legends Of Rock
programme.desc: Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more!

programme.title: Alex Baker's 30 Emo Anthems
programme.desc: Alex serves up 30 of the greatest, darkest, skinny jeans-iest, heavy eye makeup-iest & back-combed hair-iest anthems from the worlds most glorious miserable genre!

programme.title: Weekend Rock Anthems
programme.desc: Your weekend anthems and the biggest rock songs from the last 50 years! From the Beatles and the Stones in the 60s right through to One Republic and Kings Of Leon in the 10s.

programme.title: Kurt Cobain: Fan Favourites
programme.desc: From 1991 to 1994 - 40 minutes of the biggest rock songs from the legendary Kurt Cobain!

programme.title: Sunday Rock Classics
programme.desc: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

programme.title: Robin Banks 90s Antiques Rockshow
programme.desc: Crammed full with extraordinary finds, hidden treasures, and plenty of old relics! From the Stones and Genesis, to Iggy and Aerosmith - how many of these family heirlooms do you own?

programme.title: The 90s: Guitars, Grunge & Glory!
programme.desc: Grunge happened, we kept the guitars! Britpop happened, we kept the Gallaghers! Nirvana brought angst, Blur brought swagger & everyone brought riffs, anthems & questionable hair!

programme.title: 99 Reasons The 90s Rocked!
programme.desc: 99 anthems of rock from the decade that dominated the genre! With Aerosmith, Bon Jovi, Nirvana, Skunk Anansie, Meat Loaf and U2.

programme.title: Nicky Horne's Highway To Hell
programme.desc: Buckle up & join Nicky for a journey down the dark roads of rock! Monsters of metal, Ghastly Axe grinders & Devilish anthems. It's going to be a spine-tingling, HELL of a ride!

programme.title: Monsters of 80s Rock!
programme.desc: Non-stop 80s rock monsters! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, U2, The Damned & Billy Idol.

programme.title: Rosko's Hellraisers! Top 25
programme.desc: From our sister channel NOW 70s, the biggest rock n roll rebels. Presented by the man who was there "that groovy host from the west coast" Radio 1 legend Rosko!
